# telnyx_requirement_version_schedule (Action)

Schedules a future version of a regulatory requirement.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `effective_start_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the new version should become active. Must be a future date-time.
- `id` (String) The object's id.
- `requirement_type_ids` (List of String) List of requirement type UUIDs that apply to the new version. Replaces the existing requirement types for the new version.
